response.sql: WITH scan_by_status AS (SELECT sites.healtheval, SUM(scans.scancount) as total_scans, SUM(scans.gbsize) / SUM(scans.spanmin) as gb_per_minute FROM scans INNER JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry WHERE scans.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sites.healtheval), avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) as avg_gpm FROM scan_by_status) SELECT scan_by_status.healtheval as status, scan_by_status.total_scans, scan_by_status.gb_per_minute, scan_by_status.gb_per_minute - avg_calc.avg_gpm as exceeds_average FROM scan_by_status, avg_calc WHERE avg_calc.avg_gpm IS NOT NULL AND scan_by_status.gb_per_minute > avg_calc.avg_gpm ORDER BY scan_by_status.healtheval
